caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate spur, primarily colored in brown with metallic silver accents. The spur features a curved arm with engraved details along its length, and at one end, there is a large, multi-pointed rowel (the rotating wheel) secured by a silver-colored circular fastener at its center. The opposite end of the spur has a clasp mechanism and a chain, both rendered in a dark brown hue. The chain consists of two linked segments hanging vertically from the end of the spur. The entire object is presented on a light beige background, and there is a small handwritten inscription below the spur that reads "Harold M. Stiehlker."
title: Spur
